messages:
alex_cs: Heads-up: Cohort E enrollment is at 82% but participation in product feedback sessions is low. Legal also asked that we capture explicit consent for analytics in the preview. Can we coordinate a short outreach + micro-NPS + optional SSO opt-in push?

priya_success: Yes. Proposed plan: 1) 5-question micro-NPS after enablement 2) one-click analytics consent in the same email 3) follow-up enablement office hours next week.

leo_sales: We should gate executive check-ins for any accounts with NPS <= 6 or that decline analytics consent. Those are early renewal risk signals.

kate_pm: Product can generate an export of active preview orgs + last login times. If someone hasn't logged in for 14+ days, mark for churn outreach. Also support can add a flag `preview_low_engagement`.

devin_oncall: Curious about the enablement bandwidth. I can host 3 x 30m office hours slots Tue/Wed/Thu 10am PT, but we need clear agenda and a recording.

alex_cs: Agenda suggestion: 1) Quick intro + what changed 2) SSO walkthrough (optional) 3) How analytics consent is used 4) 10m Q&A. We'll record and share.

priya_success: Draft email CTA options: 
- "Acknowledge analytics update"
- "Reserve enablement office hour"
- "Request exec check-in"
Add micro-NPS: single question + optional comment box.

leo_sales: Add note to offer 1:1 session for customers with compliance teams. That tends to reduce friction.

notif_bot: [automated] Ticket CS-5588 created: "Cohort E analytics consent + micro-NPS outreach". Attachments: cohort_E_export.csv

alex_cs: Timeline: send outreach tomorrow in two waves (100 emails, then rest over 5 days). Collect NPS responses in the ticket. Priya, can you prepare email copy + subject by EOD?

priya_success: I'll post copy in the thread in 2 hours. Using subject: "Quick: Preview analytics update + 2-min feedback"

kate_pm: Product will flag accounts with low engagement and add `needs_exec_outreach` for NPS<=6. Also adding telemetry to note consent opt-in/opt-out.

devin_oncall: Quick technical note for enablement: if orgs request SSO, please have IdP metadata and admin contact. We'll do SP and IdP tests during the session. Use our shared checklist: 
```
- Collect IdP metadata (entityID, ACS URL)
- Validate certificate validity
- Test SP-initiated and IdP-initiated login
- Confirm SCIM if requested
```

alex_cs: Good. Leo: can you triage top-5 accounts with highest ARR in Cohort E before send? We want to preoffer exec check-ins.

leo_sales: On it. Posting names in DM.

priya_success: Email copy posted: 
```
Subject: Quick: Preview analytics update + 2-min feedback

Hi {FirstName},

We're making a small update to analytics in the Redwood preview program to improve data protections. Please take 2 mins to acknowledge and give us one micro-NPS score. If you'd like SSO enabled or an enablement slot, click "Reserve office hour".

[ Acknowledge update ] [ Reserve office hour ] [ Request exec check-in ]

Thanks,
Redwood Success
```

alex_cs: Nice. Can we add: "Your choice does not affect current data access; analytics opt-out only disables workspace-level usage telemetry."

priya_success: Done. Also added compliance contact: compliance@redwood.example

notif_bot: [automated reminder] Follow-up check in 48h for non-responders.

kate_pm: One more: product will hold the option to delay enforcement for 21 days for orgs undergoing audits. Tag those accounts as `audit_delay` in the export.

devin_oncall: I'll record all office hours sessions and upload to the shared drive. Please note we cannot share internal debug logs in recordings.

alex_cs: Final asks: 1) Leo - top-5 ARR triage before send 2) Priya - final copy + send schedule by EOD 3) Devin - create calendar + recording link 4) Kate - update export with `low_engagement` and `audit_delay` tags.

leo_sales: Completed ARR triage & DM'd Alex.

priya_success: Send schedule posted: first wave tomorrow 9am PT (100 emails). Tracking sheet attached.

devin_oncall: Calendar created. First office hour slot reserved. Will record.

alex_cs: Thanks team. We'll monitor NPS and consent rates; escalate any NPS<=6 accounts to renewals@redwood. Posting short status in #customer-success after wave 1. :rocket:

leo_sales: Thanks all.

priya_success: 👍
